{{Quote|Pol Handerin has a farm on the outskirts of Coronet.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />}}
[[Pol Handerin]] owned a '''farm''' on the outskirts of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Handerin got into serious trouble because of wild creatures and bandits that plagued the farm.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] dispatched a recruit to help the farmer. The CorSec agent first eliminated a pack of enraged [[carrion spat]]s, including the pack leader [[Gravefeather]], that did a lot of damage to the farm. The CorSec agent then successfully dealt with a group of criminals, the [[Nedgarr Bandits]], who damaged crops and stole grain in the farm. The CorSec agent recovered the stolen grain and eliminated several bandits, including their leader [[Trae Nedgarr]]. Pol Handerin was thankful for the help he received and that solved all the problems in his farm.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pol Handerin's farm appeared as a location in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Pol Handerin's farm was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> It was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />
